questions.question: What breed of dog is Bluey?
questions.explanation: Blue Heelers are Australian cattle dogs, and Bluey is made in Brisbane.

questions.question: What is the name of Bluey's little sister?
questions.explanation: Bingo is a Red Heeler, which is why she is orange rather than blue.

questions.question: Which cartoon do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: SpongeBob lives in a pineapple under the sea in Bikini Bottom.

questions.question: What is the name of Peppa Pig's little brother?
questions.explanation: George goes everywhere with his favourite toy, Mr Dinosaur.

questions.question: In Paw Patrol, what is the name of the boy who leads the pups?
questions.explanation: Ryder sends the pups out on their missions from the Lookout in Adventure Bay.

questions.question: Which cartoon do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Duggee runs the Squirrel Club, where the Squirrels earn a badge for every activity.

questions.question: In The Amazing World of Gumball, what kind of animal is Gumball?
questions.explanation: Gumball's brother Darwin started out as the family's pet goldfish, until he grew legs.

questions.question: Which cheese does Wallace love most in Wallace and Gromit?
questions.explanation: Wensleydale comes from the Yorkshire Dales, and Wallace cannot get enough of it.

questions.question: Which cartoon do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Pikachu is an Electric-type Pokémon, and Poké Balls are red and white.

questions.question: Which cartoon character lives in the Welsh village of Pontypandy?
questions.explanation: Fireman Sam first appeared on TV in 1987, and Postman Pat lives in Greendale.

questions.question: In which city does Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug and Cat Noir take place?
questions.explanation: Marinette, who is secretly Ladybug, lives above her parents' bakery in Paris.

questions.question: In Phineas and Ferb, what kind of animal is Perry, the secret agent pet?
questions.explanation: Perry the Platypus is secretly Agent P, always foiling the evil Dr Doofenshmirtz.

questions.question: Which Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtle wears a blue mask?
questions.explanation: Leonardo leads the team and fights with two swords called katanas.

questions.question: Which cartoon do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: The little blue Smurfs live in mushroom houses and were created by a Belgian artist called Peyo.

questions.question: In Avatar: The Last Airbender, which element did Aang first learn to bend?
questions.explanation: Aang is an Air Nomad, and as the Avatar he has to master all four elements.

questions.question: In The Simpsons, what is the name of Homer's favourite bar?
questions.explanation: The Drunken Clam is the bar in Family Guy, and Paddy's Pub is in It's Always Sunny in Philadelphia.

questions.question: Which Beatle narrated the first series of Thomas the Tank Engine & Friends in 1984?
questions.explanation: Ringo narrated the first two series, and also played Mr Conductor in America.

questions.question: In Danger Mouse, what is the name of DM's nervous hamster sidekick?
questions.explanation: In the original series Danger Mouse was voiced by David Jason and Penfold by Terry Scott.

questions.question: Which cartoon character's catchphrase is 'Yabba dabba doo!'?
questions.explanation: Fred lives in Bedrock with Wilma, and Barney Rubble is his next-door neighbour.

questions.question: Which cartoon do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: The gang solve their mysteries driving around in a van called the Mystery Machine.

questions.question: Which children's TV show do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: The show began in France, and the BBC wrote its own English stories to go with the pictures.

questions.question: Which children's TV show do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Pat delivers the post around Greendale with his black and white cat, Jess.

questions.question: Which cartoon do these emoji describe?
questions.explanation: Fry, a pizza delivery boy, is accidentally frozen and wakes up a thousand years later.

questions.question: Who provided the voices of Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck and Porky Pig for decades?
questions.explanation: Mel Blanc was known as the Man of a Thousand Voices.

questions.question: What is the name of Popeye's girlfriend?
questions.explanation: Olive Oyl was in the comic strip for nearly ten years before Popeye turned up in 1929.

questions.question: In The Clangers, how do the little knitted Clangers talk to each other?
questions.explanation: Their voices were played on swanee whistles, following the rhythm of scripts written in English.

questions.question: In which fictional town is Family Guy set?
questions.explanation: Quahog is in Rhode Island, Langley Falls is American Dad's town and Arlen is in King of the Hill.

questions.question: In which cartoon did Dick Dastardly and Muttley cheat their way through every race?
questions.explanation: For all his cheating, Dick Dastardly never won a single race.

questions.question: Which cartoon hero shouted 'By the power of Grayskull!'?
questions.explanation: Prince Adam becomes He-Man, the most powerful man in the universe, on the planet Eternia.

questions.question: Which Wallace and Gromit film introduced the villainous penguin Feathers McGraw?
questions.explanation: Feathers McGraw disguises himself as a chicken with a red rubber glove on his head.

questions.question: In Paw Patrol, which pup is the firefighter?
questions.explanation: Marshall is a Dalmatian, the classic fire station dog.

questions.question: In SpongeBob SquarePants, where does SpongeBob work as a fry cook?
questions.explanation: He flips Krabby Patties for his money-loving boss, Mr Krabs.

questions.question: In Dora the Explorer, what is the name of Dora's monkey friend?
questions.explanation: He is named after the red boots he loves to wear.

questions.question: In Bluey, what are the names of Bluey's mum and dad?
questions.explanation: Bandit is an archaeologist and Chilli works in airport security.

questions.question: In Shaun the Sheep, what is the name of the farmer's sheepdog?
questions.explanation: Bitzer tries to keep the flock in order, usually while listening to music on his headphones.

questions.question: What is the name of Homer Simpson's boss at the nuclear power plant?
questions.explanation: His full name is Charles Montgomery Burns, and his catchphrase is 'Excellent'.

questions.question: In The Flintstones, what is the name of the family's pet dinosaur?
questions.explanation: Dino barks and behaves just like a big, excitable dog.

questions.question: Which company makes the gadgets Wile E. Coyote buys to try to catch the Road Runner?
questions.explanation: Acme rockets, anvils and giant magnets never seem to work quite as planned.

questions.question: Which cartoon bear loves stealing 'pic-a-nic baskets' in Jellystone Park?
questions.explanation: His little sidekick Boo-Boo always warns him the park ranger won't like it.

questions.question: Which cartoon character has three nephews called Huey, Dewey and Louie?
questions.explanation: The three ducklings first appeared in a Donald Duck comic strip in 1937.
